title: Transcriptomic atlas reveals organ-specific disease tolerance in sickle cell mice
author: Roumenina, Lubka
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0

steps.title: Genotype and select mice
steps.instruction: Genotype all mice, then choose age‑ and sex‑matched HbAA (control) and HbSS (sickle cell) littermates that are 6–8 weeks old for the experiment.

steps.title: Anesthetize mice with isoflurane
steps.instruction: Place each mouse under isoflurane anesthesia at 2–3% concentration for all subsequent injections, blood collections, and sacrifice procedures.

steps.title: Inject hemin or PBS intravenously
steps.instruction: Inject hemin (Ferriprotoporphyrin IX, purchased from Frontiers Scientific) intravenously via the retro‑orbital sinus at 24 µmol kg⁻¹; inject phosphate‑buffered saline (PBS) into control mice.

steps.title: Incubate for post‑injection period
steps.instruction: Maintain mice for exactly 4 hours after the injection before proceeding to sacrifice.

steps.title: Euthanize mice by cervical dislocation
steps.instruction: Euthanize all mice by cervical dislocation after the 4‑hour post‑injection interval.

steps.title: Extract bone marrow RNA
steps.instruction: Harvest bone marrow and extract total RNA using the Macherey‑Nagel kit, following the manufacturer’s instructions.

steps.title: Assess RNA quality and quantity
steps.instruction: Measure RNA concentration and integrity on an Agilent 2100 Bioanalyzer using the RNA 6000 Nano Kit; accept only samples with RNA Integrity Number (RIN) > 7 for downstream work.

steps.title: Construct stranded mRNA libraries
steps.instruction: Using 1 µg of high‑quality RNA (RIN > 7), prepare libraries with the Illumina TruSeq Stranded mRNA kit according to the manufacturer’s protocol.

substeps.instruction: Incorporate dUTP instead of dTTP during second‑strand synthesis for strand specificity.
Add a single A base to the cDNA ends.
Ligate Illumina adapters to the A‑tailed cDNA.

steps.title: Quantify and profile libraries
steps.instruction: Quantify each library by qPCR with the KAPA Library Quantification Kit (KapaBiosystems) and assess library size distribution using the DNA High Sensitivity LabChip Kit on an Agilent Bioanalyzer.

steps.title: Sequence libraries on NextSeq 500
steps.instruction: Load the quantified libraries onto an Illumina NextSeq 500 and run a paired‑end 75‑base read V2 chemistry sequencing run.

steps.title: Perform primary data analysis
steps.instruction: Process raw sequencing data with AOZAN software (ENS, Paris) to demultiplex reads and perform quality control using FastQC version 0.11.5.
